adrs.text:
# 16. Time limit on direct ledger_repository access from ledger_controller

Date: 2025-09-03

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Rule R005 forbids this access, but reporting queries need a consistent read snapshot, and the proper layer will take a while.

## Decision

Existing direct access from `ledger_controller` to `ledger_repository` stays acceptable while the layer is being built, but only if it predates 2025-10-01. A dependency of this kind added after 2025-10-01 is a breach of R005.

## Consequences

Tolerated access is removed once the layer is ready.
